- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout to streamline pet naming and final confirmation. (why: Adoption step dropoff is severe with only 63.8% completion and a long median duration of 89s. A compact layout reduces friction before waiting.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Two Column Sign In Protection Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout that clearly presents account sign-in alongside pet sync protection details. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Presenting account benefits cleanly in two columns reassures returning and new users.)
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist Layout Home Intro Redesign: Redesign the final onboarding home intro screen with a checklist layout outlining key desktop interactions. (why: Finish completion drops to 68.0% and users report confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
3: [home, redesign] Spotlight Layout Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen using a spotlight layout focused on active background companion preparation status. (why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s. A spotlight layout gives visual prominence to process updates.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Trait Selection Screen: Insert a new personality trait selection screen right after pick_friend to let users customize companion behavior. (why: Adoption has the highest funnel dropoff (63.8%). Adding engaging personality trait selection increases emotional investment prior to photo upload and certification.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Preservation Sign In Safety Hint: Add an explicit safety hint below the sign in form confirming pet progress is saved automatically. (why: Multiple support emails mentioned concerns or bugs regarding lost pet progress when signing in.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Fast Generation Seal Incentive: Display a quality guarantee badge on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users of successful rendering. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures, causing dropoff during adoption.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Wait Info: Enable progress bar and hint text detailing system tray and rendering initialization during the wait step. (why: Users report app stalling or pet missing on desktop (3 emails) during the long home waiting phase (median 201s).)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Control Shortcut Home Notification: Enable ready notification toggle and add control tip component on home intro screen. (why: Support receives frequent post-onboarding confusion tickets about how to hide, control, or summon the desktop companion.)
